name: Pocket Reader
summary: Offline Markdown, plain-text, and sanitized HTML chapter reader with swipe navigation, focus mode, and saved reading progress.

help.purpose: Read local Markdown, text, and HTML documents in chapters without accounts or network access.
help.start: Import a local .md, .txt, or .html file, paste text, or load the synthetic sample reading.
help.limitations: HTML is stripped to safe text and headings; EPUB/PDF binaries are not parsed yet; browser-tested only, not an installed Android APK release.
help.data: Readings, bookmarks, reading position, and skin stay in browser localStorage on this device.
